bio.text: Shevrin D. "Shev" Jones, a Democrat, represents District 34 (part of Miami-Dade County) in the Florida Senate, elected in 2020.
According to the Florida Senate, Jones served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2012 to 2020 and was born in Miami Gardens.
Jones holds a B.S. in biochemistry and molecular biology from Florida A&M University (2006) and a master's (2017) and Ph.D. (2022) in educational leadership from Florida Atlantic University.
